cohort: 69,051 births (birth weight ≥500 g or ≥24 weeks of gestation) at a Turkish tertiary center from 2013 to 2020
finding: Groups 1, 2, 5, and 10 of the Robson Ten-Group Classification System were the major contributors to the overall cesarean delivery rate at a Turkish tertiary center.
mod_finding: Groups with a previous cesarean delivery, single cephalic presentation at term, and those classified as Robson Group 10 were major contributors to the overall cesarean delivery rate.
